bounded_hypothesis: If DESIGN.md is treated as context rather than an unconditional establish-system intent, mixed requests will route to the smallest workflow that actually performs the requested existing-surface work.
observed_failure: Any task containing DESIGN.md was routed to establish-design-system before existing-surface change or audit intent was considered.
candidate_delta: Recognize existing product-surface context across EN/KO/JA/ZH and let explicit audit or change intent win over a passive DESIGN.md mention; retain establish-design-system when no existing-surface change is requested.
rollback_gate: Revert if explicit design-system creation stops routing to omd:init or if new-surface/localization routes regress.
first_failure_rule: Any mixed existing-surface task routed to establish-design-system fails the repair.
claim_boundary: This repairs deterministic CLI routing only. It does not prove model routing reliability or complete the broader 2.0 routing gate.
next: Run workflow, CLI, and full-suite acceptance; then add ambiguity reporting instead of silently defaulting genuinely underspecified tasks.
